topic: Build a source-grounded Obsidian research corpus for SAGE-EvoBridge: bridge standards worldwide, structural forms and landmark cases, materials and fabrication, computational geometry and AI for construction. Literature research only; no invention or algorithm implementation now.
objectives: Collect primary authoritative sources, read accessible sections and papers, record exact provenance and access/read depth, synthesize engineering and AI knowledge, and publish reviewed notes into the existing Obsidian vault.
constraints: Do not modify accepted source or engineering rule artifacts; all literature is UNVERIFIED_REFERENCE until separately reviewed for applicability. No automatic progress-saving schedule.
